name: Kimi to Boku no Hana ga Saku made
original_name: 君と僕の花が咲くまで
source:
Two people who have been together since childhood, growing up side by side.

They shared joy, fun, excitement, and sometimes fought...

This is the story of their growth and romance.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ147014.html]the dlsite[/url]]
translation:
两个人从小就在一起，一起长大。

他们分享喜悦、乐趣、兴奋，有时甚至会打架……

这是他们的成长和浪漫的故事。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ147014.html]dlsite[/url]]
